description: The donut chart, titled “Stimulus Type,” visually represents the distribution of different types of stimuli used in the context of generative AI’s application in journalism, as discussed in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is segmented into ten distinct categories, each labeled with its corresponding percentage and color-coded for clarity. The largest segment is “Draft/Other” at 20.1% (dark red), followed by “Press Release” at 18.7% (golden yellow), and “External News Article” at 18.1% (dark green). Other notable segments include “Interview” (8.8%, dark blue), “Organizational Report” (7.7%, medium purple), and “Event Posting” (6.6%, maroon). Smaller segments include “Organizational Website” (4.9%, light purple), “Email” (2.7%, light green), “Social Media Post” (1.1%, orange), and a partially visible category labeled “agency” (light blue, percentage not fully visible). The chart uses a clean, circular layout with percentage labels placed outside the ring, and the central white space contains the title “Stimulus Type” in bold black text. No legend is present, as labels are directly associated with each segment. The segments appear to be ordered approximately by size, descending clockwise from the top right.
